title: Library Movement in Andhra
quote: Air is available freely to all. Knowledge too should be available likewise. - Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham

boxes.title: Rise of the organised movement
steps: Call by **Ayyanki** + Suri Venkata Narasimha in Andhra Patrika
First conference, Vijayawada (**10 April 1913**): **200 delegates**, **60 libraries**; president **Chilakamarti**
==**Andhra Desa Library Association, 1914**==: first state-level library association in India

boxes.title: Andhra Desa Library Association
items: *Grandhalaya Sarvasvam*: first Telugu library-science journal (⚠ other notes: **1916**)

items.what: **AP Public Libraries Act**: **Zilla Grandhalaya Samsthas**; Pathuri on drafting committee

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: SKDABN = ==**Hyderabad 1901**==, not Kovvur 1916 (Kovvur = Andhra Council of Research)
1918 boat tour = **Kaleswara Rao**; Bank Canal boat library = **Pathuri**
**1938** Bill vs **1948** Madras Act vs **1960** AP Act
Central library of Andhra = **Rama Mohana Library**, Vijayawada
Telangana libraries → **Andhra Jana Sangham** → Andhra Mahasabha (**Jogipet, 1930**)
